1. Read the kernel text. If it cannot be read, use the default kernel and say why.
2. With normalize on and a nonzero sum, divide every weight by the sum.
3. Pad the image with the border mode and correlate it with the kernel, anchored at its center.
4. Map the result to 8 bits with the output mapping. Keep alpha unchanged.
